claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.sourceFilter for spells and other magical effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The robe's Magic Resistance rider is still the existing modify_roll_advantage atom, but the current surface cannot scope that advantage to saving throws caused by spells or other magical effects. Without that qualifier, any encoding would overstate the item as advantage on all saving throws.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
